title: No new κ: a price-null fibre of PR6167's word (per-rank helper−paid invariant)
body:
No kappa is claimed. This adds a second legal word whose complete price has exactly the same net invoice per rank and the same raw crossing as the merged word of #6167 (kappa 0.003128645), and records why.

## What it shows

- The paid-call and helper-rank histograms both change, but together: for every rank, helpers minus paid calls is the same as in #6167. The price root depends only on those nine differences, so the crossing is identical.
- The exact freedoms: a helper with one step can be re-spanned freely; stops of a chain can be re-ordered at fixed endpoints; one stop in a main chain and one in a helper chain can trade and cancel.
- 59 words with this price were found, 58 distinct programs. Alternative Fano-plane ladder frames inserted at the 8 roots (415 single choices, all legal) do not survive frame assignment: none carries an event. The family is the freedom above, not different ladders.
- The order-4 symmetric ladder design applies to only 4 of the 8 roots here; the word is not symmetric and keeps 770 public registers.

## Evidence

`verify.py` authenticates #6167's word, price and the pinned #5827 checker chain, classifies every changed register, and replays the word through the unmodified chain (same raw crossing and net invoice, 799 endpoint columns, native maps and caller). `test_portability.py` and `scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-frontier-symmetric-ladders` pass. Author checks only; independent review is pending.

## Credit
